newsitem.title: USA: Oncogene names Robert Van Nostrand CFO.
newsitem.headline: Oncogene names Robert Van Nostrand CFO.

text.p: Oncogene Science Inc said on Thursday that it has promoted Robert Van Nostrand to the position of vice president and chief financial officer.
Van Nostrand was previously vice president of finance and administration, treasurer and secretary, Oncogene said.
It could not immediately be determined whether the chief financial officer position is newly created or if Van Nostrand is replacing someone in the position.
An Oncogene spokesman later said that Van Nostrand is not replacing anyone as chief financial officer and the promotion represents a change in title.
